SparseTrack_like.definition: Decompose active tracks and detections into pseudo-depth ordered sparse subsets, then perform hierarchical association from nearest/least-occluded to farthest/most-occluded groups
assumptions: Pseudo-depth can be approximated from image geometry such as inverse box height or footpoint position
Association uses motion and IoU consistency
invariants: Depth grouping is computed before association
Association occurs hierarchically across groups rather than one flat pass
Low-confidence detections may be recovered in a secondary stage
non_negotiable_steps: Partition crowded scene into sparse subsets

ByteTrack_baseline.definition: Associate high-confidence detections first, then recover unmatched tracks using low-confidence detections
assumptions: Confidence threshold separates high and low quality detections
invariants: Single global association without depth decomposition
